appendix.status: PARTIAL — verified latent by fresh-context subagent; not reachable on the shipped path
appendix.summary: The three agent-branch audit sites now pass actor_email=getattr(current_user,'email') unconditionally, documented as 'the key OWNER'. That premise holds for an agent-scoped MCP key but not for the EVT-001 loopback principal, whose JWT is sub='admin': a loopback dispatch that reached one of these sites would write actor_type='agent' joined to the admin human, who did not act.
appendix.why_not_a_finding: The loopback token is fenced to POST /api/agents/{name}/task; _audit_chat_started is /chat-only, and the /task replay row is gated on an Idempotency-Key the loopback never sends. No SEC-001 row is written for a loopback dispatch today.
appendix.trigger: Adding an Idempotency-Key to trigger_subscription (Invariant #18 pushes every trigger boundary toward one) makes a duplicate loopback dispatch write the misattributed row.
appendix.recommendation: Pass actor_email=None (or the vouched agent's owner email) when current_user.vouched_source_agent supplied the identity; add a loopback audit-row assertion. One line plus one test; can land as a follow-up.
appendix.pre_existing_note: The execution row's source_user_email is already the admin email on the loopback path on dev (sub='admin' predates this PR); different table, out of diff.
